show.description: “Ek Aur Anjaani Shaadi" is a light-hearted romantic drama series about Arjun and Suhani, two strangers forced to pose as a married couple to achieve their professional goals. What begins as a fake arrangement soon spirals into comic situations, emotional clashes, and unexpected chemistry. As they juggle family pressures, nosy landlords, jealous rivals, and high-stakes business deals, their pretend marriage slowly transforms into a journey of real love, destiny, and happy chaos. Watch now!
